digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflows (Tier 2 scheduled sweep)
propositions: Extend the periodic CI sweep with non-gating scheduled jobs covering Python 3.14 stable (locked), pre-release interpreters (3.15 dev, 3.14 free-threaded), Windows, full macOS suite, lower-bound dependency resolution, and external doc links.
The 3.14 stable cell must use the committed uv.lock to test interpreter compatibility against the gate's exact dependency set, producing zero genuine failures.
Sweep jobs must not set REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS when installing fewer extras than the gate, allowing importorskip self-skips rather than hard errors.
Pre-release interpreter, Windows, and doc-link jobs are non-blocking (continue-on-error); 3.14 stable, full macOS, and lower-bounds jobs are real signals.
No changes to shared reusable _build-and-test.yml or the Verified gate matrix, ensuring zero hot-path latency impact.
All five new sweep jobs must be added to EXCLUDED_JOBS in check_verify_gate_parity.py and carry --timeout=600 --timeout-method=thread where applicable.
